race.description: Aff Australian Food & Fibre Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: STREET SWAGGER (7) is the main danger after a close fourth at Dubbo and a checked second at Bathurst, with his wet-track record adding appeal. Claim helps from the right draw. DODGE THE DARK (10) was excellent first-up when beaten half a length at Narromine and brings a proven track-and-distance profile, though he rises from BM50 grade. MARIOTA (6) has been around the mark in stronger recent races, including a nose second in BM66 company at Coonamble, and the return to 1400m keeps him firmly in the winning mix. MOON ZONE (3) BM66 third two back reads well and last start had excuses. Has a wide gate but will relish the class drop.
